content:
alex_dev: quick async standup — GPU fleet capacity check

alex_dev: what I did: tuned autoscaler knobs for AMS (burst headroom + conservative backoff), rolled a small canary for t2 models. Blockers: spot eviction rate jumped to ~7% last hour, SRE alert noise. Today: coordinate reserved-pool fallback, merge autoscaler PR after review, open quota for APAC.

maria_ops: saw the eviction spikes too. I bumped reserved pool in ams by 6 GPUs and started a short drain window for non-critical batches. Can we add an emergency routing policy for same-region fallback? pinging @sam_infra to confirm quota impact. :eyes:

sam_infra: looked at the PR — left 1 comment re: backoff schedule (prefer exponential with jitter). APAC quota still pending (ticket INC-4321), asked cloud for an estimate. Also flagged possible AZ skew causing the spot pressure.

li_sre: canary looks stable so far (no increased 5xx). Quick logs from canary controller:
```
2026-03-17T13:12:02Z INFO canary: applied autoscaler v2.3.1
2026-03-17T13:15:46Z WARN node-us-east-1a: spot-eviction 3 events in 10m
2026-03-17T13:18:03Z INFO fallback: routed 12 reqs to reserved-pool-ams
```
No pages yet. If eviction rate >10% we should flip to full reserved capacity fallback.

provision-bot: scheduled: reserved capacity increase rc-2026-09 at 14:30 UTC (6 GPUs in ams). Change link: https://infra.redwood/changes/rc-2026-09

alex_dev: thanks all. I'll address sam's comment and merge after green CI. maria — can you add the routing policy stub in the infra repo (tiny PR) so we have the policy ready? I'll post a brief status update in 2h. :thumbsup:
